findings.why: Galvanica Eporediese (SUP-E) is registered only as an electroplating coater. No approved supplier list or other controlled record covers SUP-E for HB-620, the receiving plant and the customer (Nordhavn, from the 8D). QP-11 4.2 requires such an approval before delivery. Absence of a record cannot be read as 'not approved', so a person must confirm the approval status. They must also confirm that SUP-E can cast at all, and the receiving plant.
